answer_1.quote: Finally, we use state-of-the-art language models to generate claim-focused summaries from the retrieved content.

answer_3.quote: We experiment with using ChatGPT (gpt-3.5-turbo) as the classifier in the final stage.

answer_4.quote: We carry out two human studies, on comprehensiveness and faithfulness, to better understand intermediate outputs of the system.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to label summaries for faithfulness using predefined categories and comprehensiveness by assessing subquestion answerability.
